backupTip: Please manually back up site data before restore to avoid data loss
checkFailed: Check failed, please try again later
logFallback: Live channel unavailable, switched to polling
identical: The local code matches the official code
addNotRestorable: An "Added" file only exists locally, so there is no official content to restore
restoreConfirmTip: %count% selected file(s) (%size%) will be overwritten with the official content. Originals are backed up first.
restoreConsequenceOverwrite: The selected files are replaced by the official package content: any local customization made to them is permanently lost, because the official package does not contain those changes.
restoreConsequenceDeleted: A "Deleted" item is a file that exists officially but is missing locally — restoring it puts the file back on the site.
restoreConsequenceBackup: Originals are backed up on the server first under runtime/integrity/backup (grouped by timestamp and target); the exact path for this run is shown in the result. Backups are never cleaned automatically and there is no one-click rollback — restore manually from the backup directory if needed.
restoreConsequenceLive: The restore takes effect immediately: the site starts using the official content. If the site is live, prefer doing this during off-peak hours.
isBlankTip: When enabled, clicking this menu opens the page in a new tab and hides the sidebar, header and tab bar, showing only the page content

axios.404: Request error, the resource was not found
axios.505: The http version does not support the request
